scope: Implement and test pure K1 core/evaluator, independently accept synthetic cases, then two real train-only cost passes. No real model index, ranking, performance or bootstrap.
source_order: Train baskets and lineage retain accepted lexical visitorid/session/time order; neighbor and fit-identity session ordering uses numeric visitorid then integer session_start_ms.
fit_identity: SHA256 of K1_Jaccard_exact_session_k500_v1 newline start,end newline, then compact JSON [session key, numeric-sorted distinct items] plus newline in numeric session-key order. Training audit counts retained separately.
index: Read-only session item frozensets, complete item postings and support. Every posting count must equal C1 S_i; no model construction on real data this round.
ranking: All positive-overlap sessions considered before exact top500; complete pool SHA records key/intersection/union in numeric-key order. Selected-neighbor records, rational scores, boundary ties, self-session exclusions and full zero-fill diagnostics retained.
synthetic_evaluation: Four-arm exact key/history/target/candidate alignment and copied original controls; main, conditional and all fixed slices; primary K1-C1 2000 visitor-cluster bootstrap. P0/C1/D1 models are generated only on artificial fixtures.
control_provenance: Synthetic reference wrappers carry all three control fit IDs. A future real entry must bind original P0/C1/D1 bytes and loaders independently; the in-memory evaluator alone is not an accepted real-data entry.
independent_oracle: No imports from K1 production or evaluator. SQL DISTINCT train membership and postings; brute-force all sessions, complete candidate scoring/sorting, separate prefix history; inherited independent Decimal metrics and Counter/struct bootstrap replay. Full nested output/model/lineage/aggregate readback.
train_cost: First streaming train sets checked against all C1 train-session lineage, then independent direct CSV/per-session SQL DISTINCT pass checks every ledger row and membership SHA. Nontrain item JSON is never decoded. Existing C1 support supplies exact sum/max posting lengths; no new global support/index fit.
lifecycle: Only absent preparation namespace may start; preserve started/failure/partial evidence. Completed --prepare delegates to read-only verify. No automatic retry, overwrite, sampling, k reduction or relaxed denominator.
resources: Parent 8 GiB RSS / 20 GiB execution disk / 6h with 8 GiB free disk and 4 GiB available memory floors. Cooperative 0.5s checks during cost rows/SQL and phase boundaries; sampled, not OS-hard.
future_work: Separately implement/accept/freeze a source-bound real validation dispatcher and complete full-data oracle before any real validation run. Final selection/refit/test remain separate. This implementation freeze does not unlock them.
